'''David Nibbelin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2001 Fort Worth tournament]] on 7 October 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYC Flip]], according to Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3037">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-txd3037/ when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-tx], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 8 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-08-when-scrubs-attack-fort-worth-txd3037/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
